26280-the-renewal-of-life-how-and-when-t.title: _How and When to Tell the Story to the Young_
26280-the-renewal-of-life-how-and-when-t.creator: Unknown
26280-the-renewal-of-life-how-and-when-t.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Every human being must sooner or later know the facts concerning the origin of his life on the earth. One of the most puzzling questions is how and when such information should be given to the young.

arxiv-1805-06401.title: Towards establishing lepton flavour universality violation in B ¯ → K ¯ ∗ ​ ℓ + ​ ℓ − \bar{B}\to\bar{K}^{*}\ell^{+}\ell^{-} decays
arxiv-1805-06401.creator: Andrea Mauri, Nicola Serra, Rafael Silva Coutinho
arxiv-1805-06401.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Andrea Mauri, Nicola Serra, Rafael Silva Coutinho. Rare semileptonic b → s ​ ℓ + ​ ℓ − b\to s\ell^{+}\ell^{-} transitions provide some of the most promising frameworks to search for new physics effects. Recent analyses of these decays have indicated an anomalous behaviour in measurements of angular distributions of the decay B 0 → K ∗ ​ μ + ​ μ − B^{0}\to K^{*}\mu^{+}\mu^{-} and lepton-flavour-universality observables.

arxiv-2104-09504.title: Constant-roll warm inflation and the β \beta -function approach
arxiv-2104-09504.creator: Ui Ri Mun
arxiv-2104-09504.description: Abstract We propose a new approach to constant-roll warm inflation as a generalization of constant-roll inflation. Based on the β \beta -function formalism, it is shown that constant-roll warm inflation models with a natural end fall into universality classes defined by three different types of β \beta -functions, under the assumption that radiation energy density is quasi-stable.

arxiv-2204-09235.title: Janus AQP : Efficient Partition Tree Maintenance for Dynamic Approximate Query Processing
arxiv-2204-09235.creator: Xi Liang, Stavros Sintos, Sanjay Krishnan
arxiv-2204-09235.description: Abstract . Approximate query processing over dynamic databases, i.e., under insertions/deletions, has applications ranging from high-frequency trading to internet-of-things analytics. We present Janus AQP , a new dynamic AQP system, which supports SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN, and MAX queries under insertions and deletions to the dataset.

arxiv-2301-11850.title: Predicting Sentence-Level Factuality of News and Bias of Media Outlets
arxiv-2301-11850.creator: Francielle Vargas, Kokil Jaidka, Thiago A. S. Pardo, Fabrício Benevenuto
arxiv-2301-11850.description: Abstract Automated news credibility and fact-checking at scale require accurate prediction of news factuality and media bias. This paper introduces a large sentence-level dataset, titled FactNews 1 1 1 https://github.com/franciellevargas/FactNews , composed of 6,191 sentences expertly annotated according to factuality and media bias definitions proposed by AllSides.

arxiv-2303-02081.title: Unproportional mosaicing
arxiv-2303-02081.creator: Vojtech Molek, Petr Hurtik, Pavel Vlasanek, David Adamczyk
arxiv-2303-02081.description: Abstract Data shift is a gap between data distribution used for training and data distribution encountered in the real-world. Data augmentations help narrow the gap by generating new data samples, increasing data variability, and data space coverage. We present a new data augmentation: Unproportional mosaicing (Unprop).

arxiv-2307-16174.title: Analytical and numerical insights into wildfire dynamics: Exploring the advection–diffusion–reaction model
arxiv-2307-16174.creator: Cordula Reisch, Adrián Navas-Montilla, Ilhan Özgen-Xian
arxiv-2307-16174.description: Abstract Understanding the dynamics of wildfire is crucial for developing management and intervention strategies. Mathematical and computational models can be used to improve our understanding of wildfire processes and dynamics. This paper presents a systematic study of a widely used advection–diffusion–reaction wildfire model with non-linear coupling. The importance of single mechanisms is discovered by analysing hierarchical sub-models.

arxiv-2505-04483.description: Abstract . arxiv-2509-24935.title: Scalable GANs with Transformers
arxiv-2509-24935.creator: Sangeek Hyun, MinKyu Lee, Jae-Pil Heo
arxiv-2509-24935.description: Abstract Scalability has driven recent advances in generative modeling, yet its principles remain underexplored for adversarial learning. We investigate the scalability of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) through two design choices that have proven to be effective in other types of generative models: training in a compact Variational Autoencoder latent space and adopting purely transformer-based generators and discriminators.

pmc-11690711.creator: Jessica Finlay, Grace Bowman, Matthew Miller, Colleen Reid
pmc-11690711.description: Little is known about the health impacts of wildland urban interface (WUI) fires, which are increasingly common and mostly burn human-made materials. The Marshall Fire Community Health Research Study investigated a destructive WUI fire that affected communities of Superior and Louisville (CO) on December 30, 2021.

pmc-12549948.title: NFC/RFID-enabled wearables and implants for biomedical applications
pmc-12549948.creator: Haochen Zou, Zhibo Zhou, Mengyao Huang, Wenhao Li, Bowen Yang, Xiao Zhao, Ting Li, Lijie Xu, Ting Wang, Lianhui Wang
pmc-12549948.description: Near Field Communication (NFC) and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technologies offer wireless data transmission and energy supply for flexible wearable and implantable sensing systems. By eliminating bulky batteries or external wiring, these technologies significantly advance personalized medicine through wearable and implantable systems with reduced size, increased flexibility, and improved mechanical adaptability to the human body.

pmc-12822254.title: QIIME2 pipeline for ITS2-based nemabiome sequencing in veterinary species and the importance of analysis parameters
pmc-12822254.creator: Jeba R J Jesudoss Chelladurai, Theresa A Quintana, Aloysius Abraham
pmc-12822254.description: BackgroundDeep amplicon sequencing of nematode internal transcribed spacer 2 (ITS2), also referred to as the “nemabiome,” has been increasingly used in veterinary hosts to study gastrointestinal nematodes. While post-sequencing bioinformatic pipelines such as DADA2 and mothur have been optimized, most researchers typically use the DADA2 pipeline in R. For optimal performance, DADA2 needs parameter tuning, which is hard for novices.

pmc-13070050.creator: Lu Liu, Cheuk Wang Au, Ummey Hany, Alice L. Rigby, Anesha Chauhan, Catriona Brown, Jessie Sims, Gina Murillo, Marìa Gabriela Acosta de Carmargo, Chris F. Inglehearn, Christopher M. Watson, Alan J. Mighell, Claire E. L. Smith
pmc-13070050.description: Amelogenesis imperfecta (AI) is a group of rare inherited conditions causing tooth enamel defects. Human acid phosphatase 4 (ACP4) is a transmembrane protein involved in maintaining appositional enamel growth. Variants in ACP4 cause recessive hypoplastic AI. Here we identify further families and review published ACP4 variants causing AI. In three Pakistani families, we identified a new ACP4 variant, c.

pmc-13076562.title: Skeletal muscle dysfunction induced by cancer immunotherapy: mechanistics insights and surgical implications
pmc-13076562.creator: Shuang Ma, Yu Sun, Shang Sui, Xinwei Wu, Xiaolin Wu, Huixian Li
pmc-13076562.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cancer immunotherapy has revolutionized cancer treatment, yet its effects extend far beyond tumor eradication. Accumulating evidence indicates that immunotherapy-associated skeletal muscle dysfunction represents a complex, cross-organ pathological process driven by dynamic crosstalk between the tumor microenvironment and peripheral tissues. Rather than an isolated adverse event, muscle injury emerges from integrated mechanisms including inflammatory cytokine spillover, aberrant immune cell infiltration, metabolic reprogramming, vascular dysfunction, and impaired regenerative signaling.

pmc-13401797.title: The 15th ISCB Student Wikipedia Competition: past, present and future perspectives
pmc-13401797.creator: Alastair M Kilpatrick, Audra Anjum, Dan DeBlasio, Pradeep Eranti, Aarón Gallego Crespo, Megha Hegde, Tülay Karakulak, Nicolas C Näpflin, Nelly Sélem-Mojica, Lonnie R Welch, Farzana Rahman
pmc-13401797.description: The International Society for Computational Biology (ISCB) Student Wikipedia Competition, now in its 15th edition, has become a cornerstone initiative for promoting open educational resources in computational biology. Launched in 2012, the competition has engaged hundreds of students and postdoctoral researchers worldwide in editing and improving Wikipedia articles, guided by the society’s bioinformatics core competencies.
